title: FMCSA Insurance Gap Signals
description: Find FMCSA carriers with a gap between required BI&PD liability coverage and coverage on file.

states.title: States (optional)
states.description: Optional two-letter state codes. Leave empty for nationwide results.

includeInactive.title: Include inactive authorities
includeInactive.description: Include carriers whose operating authority is inactive. Disabled by default to prioritize actionable active and pending carriers.

minCoverageGap.title: Minimum coverage gap ($)
minCoverageGap.description: Minimum dollar difference between required BI&PD coverage and coverage currently on file.

minScore.title: Minimum signal score
minScore.description: Only return carriers whose deterministic insurance-opportunity score meets this threshold.

maxResults.title: Maximum signals
maxResults.description: Maximum number of qualifying carrier signals to return in one run.
